Application scenarios: enterprise open-plan offices, R&D centers, customer-service centers. The system periodically (e.g., hourly) generates stress heatmaps for organizational-health monitoring. Skill features: long-term high-intensity work stress reduces efficiency, increases turnover, and causes burnout.
